newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH JUSTICE MINISTER THREATENS TO RESIGN.
newsitem.headline: POLISH JUSTICE MINISTER THREATENS TO RESIGN.

text.p: Polish Justice Minister Leszek Kubicki has threatened to resign unless his ministry receives more funds, private Radio Zet said on Monday.
Kubicki told the radio he was considering submitting his resignation on Tuesday unless the Finance Ministry increased funding for his ministry in next year's budget.
Kubicki, he also doubles as prosecutor-general, said the meagre resources at his disposal made it impossible for him to carry out his constitutional duties.
